scope_note: Machine-readable sign, frame, rotation, unit, and control-affine conventions for AffineDrift prose and agents. Cite rendered pages with .html anchors; use UpstreamDrift Conventions for pinned code array layouts.

conventions.name: SI base and derived units
conventions.summary: Kinematic and dynamic quantities use SI unless a chapter declares otherwise: length m, mass kg, time s, force N, torque N·m, angles rad in dynamics.

conventions.name: Control-affine drift and control split
conventions.summary: Plant ẋ = f_p(x) + G_p(x)u; drift is autonomous evolution at u=0; control is the channel zeroed by a counterfactual.

conventions.name: Uppercase G control map
conventions.summary: Uppercase G(x) maps declared control to generalized forces in control-affine equations; lowercase g(x) is not the input map.

conventions.name: Hamilton quaternion (scalar-first)
conventions.summary: Unit quaternions q=(w,x,y,z) with w²+x²+y²+z²=1; active rotation v'=qvq* on column vectors; q_WB maps body to world.

conventions.name: Intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler (yaw-pitch-roll)
conventions.summary: Default body-to-world active rotation R = R_Z(ψ) R_Y(θ) R_X(φ); gimbal lock at θ=±π/2.

conventions.name: Spatial twist block order
conventions.summary: Twists use V=(ω,v): angular velocity block first, then linear velocity of the reference point.

conventions.name: Spatial wrench block order
conventions.summary: Wrenches use W=(n,f): moment about the reference point first, then force; power P=WᵀV.

conventions.name: Site default target frame (Z-up)
conventions.summary: +X along target line downrange, +Y golfer's left when looking downrange, +Z up; right-handed.

conventions.name: Y-up impact and green target frame
conventions.summary: +X along target line, +Y up, +Z golfer's right when looking downrange; map to site Z-up before cross-article signing.

conventions.name: Cross product (right-hand rule)
conventions.summary: u×v follows the right-hand rule; torque τ = r×F uses the same convention.

conventions.name: Angular velocity axis (right-hand rule)
conventions.summary: Thumb along ω; fingers curl in the positive rotation sense; counterclockwise positive when viewed from +ω.

conventions.name: DCR weighting on the left
conventions.summary: DCR norms apply W on the left: ‖Wa_d‖₂ / (sup_{u∈𝒰} ‖W B_a u‖₂ + ε); declare equivalence to ‖·‖_M when using a metric.

conventions.name: Coefficient of restitution (COR)
conventions.summary: e = −(v_b⁺−v_c⁺)·n / (v_b⁻−v_c⁻)·n with unit normal n; passive non-superelastic rebounds give e∈[0,1].

conventions.name: DCR vs DgCR acronyms
conventions.summary: DCR is reserved for Drift-Control Ratio; restitution drag-curve ratio is DgCR = (1−COR)/(1+COR), always positive.

conventions.name: Pointwise ZTCF and ZVCF acceleration split
conventions.summary: At fixed (q,q̇,z,p): q̈ = a_ZTCF + a_ZVCF with u=0 drift and measured control operand; identity is instantaneous only.

conventions.name: UpstreamDrift canonical-v2 SI gravity
conventions.summary: At pinned UpstreamDrift: SI (m, kg, s), world Z-up, g=[0,0,-9.80665] m/s² in canonical-v2; dynamic q/v in radians.

conventions.name: UpstreamDrift spatial Jacobian rows
conventions.summary: Suite-wide spatial Jacobian is [angular; linear]; Pinocchio and Drake adapters restack to match engine_core contract.
